stale_claim_policy.release_condition: No repository mutation, workflow run, durable receipt, or issue update within claim_ttl_days.
stale_claim_policy.required_action: Release, renew with fresh evidence, or reassign to the next nonconflicting internal execution lane.

collision_boundaries: Do not reactivate the secret-bound Cloudflare lane as competing active implementation without explicit claim release.
Do not send participants to GitHub.

collision_boundaries: Contract-test fixtures may not be promoted as real review decisions.
Private review grants no publication, release, or Master Record authority.

collision_boundaries: No final Master Record may be created or applied by this claim.
